title: Bounded expected halting time
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $B$ be rational. The machine's cumulative probability of not having halted, summed over all times $t<K$, is at most $B$ for every natural number $K$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a finite Boolean input string
